title: Isaac L NDE 22019
content: I was young. My mother and I went to visit my uncle near his office complex. The complex had a swimming pool, so I went dressed to swim. I was young and very big-headed. I thought I was a great swimmer, though I had never taken swimming lessons or gone swimming in deep water. I took two floaters into the water and was straddling them as I floated. My mother and uncle sat on the concrete and talked. I floated, without realizing it, into the deep end of the pool. Suddenly, I slipped between the wet noodles and fell into the water. Being completely inexperienced in swimming, I sunk straight to the bottom and started inhaling water quickly. I saw a light, and started to thrash and walk toward it. I seemed to move unnaturally slowly and fluidly. I thought the light was a light at the edge of the pool, and I was planning to reach it and pull myself up and out of the water. I almost reached it when my uncle's strong arms gripped me and pulled me up. He had jumped in, in his business suit, to save me. When I talked to my mom much later, she said I hadn't moved from where I had fallen in the water - my conclusion is that my spirit left my body and was moving to the next life. Though the experience was about ten years ago, I still remember it vividly.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I didn't look down at myself - I was just walking toward the light.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It was a vertical oval of very bright light.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Shock and extreme panic at first, as I fell into the water, then calm and focused as I walked toward the light.

elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes The friend I shared it with was interested, as he is highly intrigued by out of body experiences.
